slice: suspension shops (regional), from rider threads and the Racer X Shop Network

products.product: Art of War Suspension Revalve (Showa / KYB / WP)
products.what_it_changes: Fork and shock revalve and setup for the rider's weight, speed and terrain. Mooresville / Charlotte area, North Carolina.
products.caveats: Shop details from rider posts (2024); confirm services and turnaround with the shop.
rider_feedback: Five riders in a 2024 Vital MX thread recommend it, several naming it a top choice for Showa.

products.what_it_changes: Fork and shock revalve and setup for the rider's weight, speed and terrain. North Carolina.
products.caveats: City not stated by the riders; confirm with the shop.
rider_feedback: Two riders in a 2024 Vital MX thread praise the suspension and engine work, a quick turnaround before a race and good communication.

products.what_it_changes: Fork and shock revalve and setup for the rider's weight, speed and terrain. Hendersonville, North Carolina.
rider_feedback: One rider in a 2024 Vital MX thread calls it an excellent shop with friendly staff.

products.what_it_changes: Fork and shock revalve and setup for the rider's weight, speed and terrain. Warren, Ohio (a second location in Beaver Falls, Pennsylvania).
rider_feedback: One rider in a 2024 Vital MX thread prefers the Warren, Ohio location.

products.product: Suspension Done Right Revalve and Service
products.what_it_changes: Fork and shock revalve and setup for the rider's weight, speed and terrain. Salem, Alabama. Phone 334-650-9895; suspensiondr.com.
products.caveats: Listed in the Racer X Shop Network (April 2025). Services and bike list not published there.

products.what_it_changes: Fork and shock revalve and setup for the rider's weight, speed and terrain. Dade City, Florida. 13710 Bellamy Bros. Blvd.; phone 813-714-2038.
products.caveats: Named a Race Tech Center in a June 2012 press release; not confirmed as still operating. Call before sending anything.

not_done: Engine builders named by riders (Twisted Development, XPR, TLR in Florida, Tom Zont Racing, Dasa Racing, Proven Motors, Varner Motorsports, MMR, JM Racing in Houston; Vital MX 2020 thread https://www.vitalmx.com/forums/Moto-Related,20/4-stroke-Motor-Builders,1379548) and Pro Circuit motor services (https://www.procircuit.com/motor-services: head and cylinder modification, crank rebuild, valve seats, replating, supermini engines; quote by phone, 5-7 business days) are not in the app: the Garage has no engine-builder slot yet.
Wheel builders (Dubya USA, Orange, California: custom wheel builder with Talon, Kite, D.I.D and Excel) likewise.
